_meta.description: AutoTube AI Models Registry — all models the system can hook into, ranked by quality
_meta.usage: Each section (image_models, script_models, tts_models) lists models ranked best → worst. Set the active model by its 'id'. The system reads this file at runtime.
_meta.ranking_note: Rankings are based on output quality, prompt adherence, and reliability. 'tier' values: S (best), A (great), B (good), C (usable). 'cost' values: free, freemium, paid.

video_models._description: Models for generating cinematic motion video from images

models.label: Kling 1.6 (Standard)
models.notes: Best quality. ~8 credits/s for 1080p, ~6 credits/s for 720p

models.label: Kling 1.6 Turbo
models.notes: Faster, lower cost. Good for testing and social media.

image_models._description: Models for generating scene images. Ranked by visual quality and prompt accuracy.

pollinations._description: Pollinations.ai models — free, no API key required for basic use

models.label: FLUX (Black Forest Labs)
models.description: Industry-leading open model. Exceptional photorealism, prompt adherence, and text rendering.
models.notes: Default recommended model. Consistent high quality across all styles.

models.label: Nanobanana 2 (Google)
models.description: Google's multimodal image model. Strong semantic understanding and instruction following.
models.notes: Excellent for scenes that need precise composition and multiple elements.

models.label: Seedream 5 Pro (ByteDance)
models.description: ByteDance's flagship image model. Beautiful aesthetics and strong text rendering.
models.notes: Often produces the most visually striking results for artistic styles.

models.label: Ideogram V4
models.description: Best-in-class for typography and text accuracy in generated images.
models.notes: Use this when your images need readable, accurate text overlays.

models.label: GPT Image (OpenAI)
models.description: OpenAI's image model via Pollinations. Easy prompt following, natural compositions.
models.notes: Very forgiving with prompt wording. Good fallback option.

models.label: Seedream 5 (ByteDance)
models.description: Faster variant of Seedream. Slightly lower quality but better throughput.
models.notes: Use when speed matters more than maximum quality.

models.label: Nanobanana 2 Lite (Google)
models.description: Lightweight version of Nanobanana. Faster with slightly less detail.
models.notes: Good for testing pipeline before switching to heavier models.

models.label: Kontext
models.description: Specialized for style transformations and image editing tasks.
models.notes: Better for modifying existing images than generating from scratch.

models.label: Wan Image
models.description: Chinese open-weight image model with strong aesthetic quality.
models.notes: Can produce unique results that differ from Western-trained models.

models.label: Klein
models.description: Lightweight model for quick generation. Lower detail but reliable.
models.notes: Use as a last-resort fallback. Fast but limited detail.

huggingface._description: HuggingFace Inference API models — requires HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN env var

models.label: FLUX.1 Dev (Black Forest Labs)
models.description: Full FLUX.1 development model. Best open-weight quality available for self-hosting.
models.notes: May require paid inference or dedicated endpoint for reliable access. Non-commercial license.

models.label: FLUX.1 Schnell (Black Forest Labs)
models.description: Speed-optimized FLUX variant. 4-step generation for rapid output.
models.notes: Apache 2.0 license — fully free for commercial use. Much faster than dev.

models.label: Stable Diffusion XL (Stability AI)
models.description: The most customizable image model. Massive ecosystem of LoRAs and ControlNets.
models.notes: Best if you want to load custom style LoRAs from CivitAI. Requires more prompt engineering.

models.label: Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large (Stability AI)
models.description: Latest Stable Diffusion with improved architecture. Better text and composition.
models.notes: May have rate limits on free tier. Check HuggingFace for current availability.

models.label: Z-Image (Tongyi)
models.description: Already integrated in AutoTube. Good quality with occasional cold starts.
models.notes: Currently configured as the HuggingFace option in ai_generator.py. Cold start can take 30-60s.

self_hosted._description: Models you can run locally with ComfyUI, Forge, or Diffusers. Requires GPU (8GB+ VRAM).

models.label: FLUX.1 Dev (Local)
models.description: Run FLUX locally for unlimited, private generation. Best quality.

models.label: Stable Diffusion XL (Local)
models.description: Run SDXL locally with full LoRA and ControlNet support.

script_models._description: LLM models for AI script writing. Used in the n8n AI Script Writer node. Ranked by creative writing quality.
script_models._auth: Bearer token — set GROQ_API_KEY in your Groq credential

groq._description: Groq-hosted models — ultra-fast inference, free tier available

models.label: Llama 3.3 70B Versatile (Meta)
models.description: Best open-weight model for creative writing. Natural dialogue, strong narrative flow, excellent instruction following.
models.notes: Upgrade pick from the current llama-3.1-8b. Dramatically better scripts with richer language.

models.label: Qwen QWQ 32B (Alibaba)
models.description: Excellent reasoning model with thinking capabilities. Great for structured script outlines and complex topics.
models.notes: Has 'thinking' mode — useful for planning script structure before writing.

models.label: DeepSeek R1 Distill 70B
models.description: Reasoning-optimized model. Best for factual, technical, or educational scripts that need accuracy.
models.notes: Less 'creative flair' than Llama but more factually precise. Good for science/tech topics.

models.label: Llama 3.1 8B Instant (Meta)
models.description: Current default in AutoTube. Fast and reliable but limited creativity compared to larger models.
models.notes: Currently configured in autotube-complete.json. Works but upgrading to 70B is recommended.

models.label: GPT-OSS 20B (OpenAI)
models.description: OpenAI's open-weight model on Groq. Balanced quality and speed.
models.notes: Good middle ground if Llama 70B is rate-limited.

models.label: Groq Compound (Groq)
models.description: Groq's integrated system with built-in web search and tool use. Can research topics before writing.
models.notes: Unique ability to search the web for up-to-date info before writing the script.

pollinations_text._description: Text models available through Pollinations (free, no key needed)

models.label: OpenAI GPT (via Pollinations)
models.description: Access OpenAI models for free through Pollinations text API.
models.notes: No API key needed. Good fallback if Groq is down.

models.label: Mistral (via Pollinations)
models.description: Mistral models accessible through Pollinations.
models.notes: Good for multilingual script generation.

models.label: DeepSeek (via Pollinations)
models.description: DeepSeek models via Pollinations for reasoning-heavy tasks.
models.notes: Free alternative to Groq-hosted DeepSeek.

tts_models._description: Text-to-Speech models for voiceover generation. Ranked by voice naturalness.
tts_models._auth: Bearer token — same Groq API key as script models

groq_tts._description: Groq-hosted TTS models with ultra-fast synthesis

models.label: Orpheus V1 English (Canopy Labs)
models.description: Currently configured in AutoTube. Expressive English TTS with vocal direction support.

voice_guide.troy: Deep male — authoritative, confident. Best for: tech, business, cinematic.
voice_guide.autumn: Warm female — friendly, approachable. Best for: lifestyle, educational, wellness.
voice_guide.hannah: Young female — energetic, bright. Best for: pop culture, trends, upbeat content.
voice_guide.daniel: Neutral male — clear, professional. Best for: explainers, news, general. (Current default)
voice_guide.austin: Casual male — relaxed, conversational. Best for: gaming, comedy, casual topics.
voice_guide.diana: Mature female — elegant, composed. Best for: luxury, art, sophisticated content.

models.notes: Supports vocal direction tags: [cheerful], [sad], [whisper], <giggle>, <sigh>. Insert these in your script text for emotional control.

models.label: Orpheus Arabic Saudi (Canopy Labs)
models.description: Authentic Saudi Arabic dialect synthesis.
models.notes: Use for Arabic-language YouTube Shorts targeting Gulf region audiences.

recommended_combos._description: Pre-tested model combinations ranked by overall output quality. Use these as starting presets.

maximum_quality.label: 🏆 Maximum Quality
maximum_quality.description: Best possible output — slower but stunning results.
maximum_quality.notes: Use this for your best content. ~3-5 min per video.

balanced.label: ⚖️ Balanced (Recommended)
balanced.description: Great quality with reasonable speed. Best daily driver.
balanced.notes: Recommended starting point. ~2-4 min per video.

speed_run.label: ⚡ Speed Run
speed_run.description: Fastest possible pipeline — good for bulk generation and testing.
speed_run.notes: Use for batch runs or testing. ~1-2 min per video.

artistic.label: 🎨 Artistic
artistic.description: Optimized for visual art styles — anime, manga, painting, etc.
artistic.notes: Pair with illustration-category styles from style_prompts.json.

educational.label: 📚 Educational
educational.notes: DeepSeek's reasoning ensures factual accuracy. Nanobanana handles complex diagrams well.
